newsitem.title: USA: Fort Howard LBO investors distribute shrs.
newsitem.headline: Fort Howard LBO investors distribute shrs.

text.p: Fort Howard Corp, which plans to merge with James River Corp, said the Morgan Stanley Leveraged Equity Fund II LP and two related limited partnerships which invested in its 1998 leveraged buyout, have distributed Fort Howard shares to their respective partners.
They distributed a total of 17 million Fort Howard common shares with par value $0.01 per share, which represented the partnerships' entire investment in Fort Howard, it said.
As a result, Morgan Stanley Group, First Plaza Group Trust and Leeway & Co received a total of 9.5 million shares, it said.

Through certain direct investments also made in connection with the leveraged buyout and subsequent financings, these investors owned a total additional 10.5 million shares, for a total 20 million shares, it said.

As the company already announced in connection with its proposed $5.8 billion merger with James River, Morgan Stanley, First Plaza Group Trust and Leeway & Co have agreed not to transfer these shares prior to the closing of the merger and to vote all such shares in favor of the merger, it said.
